entities.title: Equipment
entities.summary: The twelve items a station sells, by tech level, their prices and what buying each does.
entities.purpose: Owns the equipment shop of RULES A.12: the items in their fixed order, which a system offers by tech level, prices, and the effect of buying each one, as the list-based panel calls it (deliberate difference 12); also the escape-pod rescue, sun-fuel scooping and the energy recharge rate the fitted items set.
boundaries: A capability: it uses no feature or use case (tests/layers.rs).
Names and prices are the GDD's (§ 4.8, § 5.3).
